what: Work cards stacked in one slot swap every 3 seconds. The current card tilts 50px left and −4° while blurring out, and the next card comes in upright from 50px right at 4° (.8s cubic-bezier(.17,.84,.44,1)). In the stack type, a pale standby card tilted 4° sits behind. On advance, while the front card leaves, the standby card changes from the pale tint to its real face and straightens up (.6s ease-out). .2s later the following card appears tilted as the new standby card. Pressing prev or next restarts the auto-advance count from zero.

options.start: Seconds until auto-advance turns on after attaching, default 0 — the original hero is .45 (measuring the original, first advance 3.45s, second 6.45s)
options.look: If stack, tilted waiting cards are laid out behind (original Work slider)
options.--fx-stack-dur: (css) Stack type entry and wait length, default .6s
options.--fx-standby·--fx-face: (css) stack type waiting card color and line, card face color, default --kf-accent-soft · --kf-surface
options.[data-fx-part=track·prev·next]: Container holding the cards (track, or the element itself if none) · prev and next buttons. Also advances via fx:next and fx:prev events

note: The original swaps CSS keyframe classes (no GSAP). Stack type cards animate their background color, so the card surface is painted with background-color.

from.where: index.html .sd-hero__slider (original #main_slider-track — slideOut/slideIn .8s, 3s, starts after the panel opacity transition ends)·.sd-work__slider (#work_slider-track — useAdvancedAnimation: slideInWork .6s ease-out · slideStandby after 200ms)
